dataFlow: Builder platforms remain authoritative for their application code and native runtime state.
Macaly/Convex remains the central structured repository and authorization boundary for controlled repository records.
GitHub stores sanitized public manifests, bridge code, versioned documentation, and deployment artifacts.
Staff SharePoint receives protected operational references and approved source documents once SharePoint Online is licensed.
Client SharePoint and Google Sites consume only approved public content and read-only feeds.
Google Drive remains a protected source/reference document layer unless a document is independently approved for external publication.
